播种前未浸透，播种至提高水位间隔约3天，种子位置完全干燥，此前仅早晚喷壶喷水；后: The sponge was not fully soaked before sowing. The water level was raised approximately three days after sowing; the seed positions were completely dry. Previously, water had only been sprayed morning and evening. The bottom later contacted water, but the middle and upper sections remained dry. The tray was indoors with direct midday sunlight and a night temperature of approximately 20 °C.
